why: The upper half of the domino gains 2 dots each time (1, 3, 5, 7) and the lower half loses 1 dot each time (5, 4, 3, 2). The book gives option 4 as the answer (6 dots on top, 1 dot below). By counting, C should have 5 dots on top and 3 below, which is option 5, so check the dots carefully.
trick: In domino series, count the dots in each half separately and look for +1, +2 or -1 steps.
note: Book answer is option 4, but by dot counting (top 1,3,?,7 and bottom 5,4,?,2) option 5 (top 5, bottom 3) fits better. Option 4 looks like 6 top / 1 bottom. Small dots in the scan are hard to count exactly.
